```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, error = FALSE, echo = FALSE)
```

```{r lib_load}
library(tidyverse)   # data wrangling & ggplot2
library(janitor)     # functions for examining and cleaning dirty data
library(kableExtra)  # simple table generator
library(here)        # Find files within a project
library(olsrr)       # package for p-value backward elimination
library(broom)       # summarizes key information about models
library(rlang)       # functions for Base Types and Core R and 'Tidyverse' Features
library(car)         # VIF, influence measures helpers
library(scales)      # provides the internal scaling infrastructure used by ggplot
library(fastDummies) # Fast Creation of Dummy (Binary) Columns & Rows from Categorical Variables
```

```{r fun, results='hide'}
codf    <- readRDS(file = here("rmds/modfunctions", "codfunctions.rds"))
codform <- readRDS(file = here("rmds", "codformulas.rds"))

codf_env <- list2env(codf, parent = globalenv())
for (nm in names(codf)) {environment(codf[[nm]]) <- codf_env}
list2env(codf, envir = codf_env)
```

```{r data_import}
df <- read_csv(here("data/city", "salesSFapr2023toMarch2025Updated.csv")) |>
  rename_with(tolower) |> filter(ccd == 3)

res23    <- codf$prep_cod_sales(df, origin_month = as.Date("2023-04-01"))
df       <- res23$data
ecfs_col <- res23$ecfs_col
```

---

## Model I

```{r mod1}
mod_time <- codf$backward_p(formula = codform$formula_time, data = df, p_out = 0.10, verbose = TRUE)
df <- codf$make_time_adjusted_df(df, codform$formula_time)

codf$plot_standard_residual_hist(mod_time, df, ptitle = "Histogram\nDependent Variable: LN_SPPSF")
```

```{r mod1a, results='asis'}
codf$model_metrics_A(mod_time, "District 3 LN\\_SPPSF model fit statistics")
codf$coef_table(mod_time, "District 3 LN\\_SPPSF model coefficients (95% CI)")
```

```{r mod1b}
mf <- model.frame(mod_time)
row_idx <- as.integer(rownames(mf))
aug_sppsf <- broom::augment(mod_time, data = df[row_idx, ]) |>
  dplyr::mutate(pred_sppsf = exp(.fitted), std_resid  = .std.resid)
codf$plot_residuals_vs_months(aug_sppsf, ptitle = "Residuals for LN_SPPSF Model")
```

```{r mod1c}
codf$plot_predicted_sppsf_vs_months(aug_sppsf, ptitle = "Months vs Predicted SPPSF - LN_SPPSF Model")
```

```{r mod1d}
codf$plot_price_index_vs_months(df)
```

```{r mod1e}
codf$plot_taf_vs_months(df)
```

## Model II

```{r mod2}
mod_ln_price_no_ecf <- codf$backward_p(codform$formula_ln_price_no_ecf,
                                  data = df, p_out = 0.10, verbose = TRUE)

codf$plot_standard_residual_hist(mod_ln_price_no_ecf, df,
                                 ptitle = "Histogram\nDependent Variable: LN_PRICE (No ECFs)")
```

```{r mod2a, results='asis'}
codf$model_metrics_A(mod_ln_price_no_ecf, "District 3 LN\\_PRICE (No ECFs) model fit statistics")
codf$coef_table(mod_ln_price_no_ecf, "District 3 LN\\_PRICE (No ECFs) model coefficients (95% CI)")
```

```{r mod2b}
mf <- model.frame(mod_ln_price_no_ecf)
row_idx <- as.integer(rownames(mf))
aug_sppsf <- broom::augment(mod_ln_price_no_ecf, data = df[row_idx, ]) |>
  dplyr::mutate(pred_sppsf = exp(.fitted), std_resid  = .std.resid)
codf$plot_residuals_vs_months(aug_sppsf, ptitle = "Residuals for LN_PRICE (No ECFs) Model")
```

```{r mod2c}
codf$plot_leverage_histogram(model = mod_ln_price_no_ecf, df = df, subtitle = "Dependent Variable: LN\\_PRICE")
```

```{r mod2d}
codf$pp_plot_resid(mod_ln_price_no_ecf, dep_label = "LN_PRICE")
```

```{r mod2e}
codf$plot_stdresid_vs_stdpred(mod_ln_price_no_ecf, dep_label = "LN_PRICE")
```

```{r mod2f}
codf$plot_cook_vs_rstudent(mod_ln_price_no_ecf, dep_label = "LN_PRICE")
```

```{r mod2g}
codf$plot_lev_vs_rstudent(mod_ln_price_no_ecf, dep_label = "LN_PRICE")
```

## Model III

### Initial Input

```{r ecfcheck, eval=FALSE}
head(ecfs_col, 40)
```

```{r mod3}
baserh <- c(
  "ln_landratio", "ln_base_bldgsize_ratio", "arterial",
  "single_family1story", "half_duplex1story", "half_duplex2story",
  "smallest", "small", "large", "largest", "two_plus_baths", "powder_room",
  "good", "fair", "poor", "very_poor_unsound", "qabove_avg", "qbelow_avg",
  "yb_pre_1929", "yb_1946_to_1960", "yb_post_1961", "crawl", "slab",
  "ln_garagespaces", "fireplace", "hot_water", "elec_baseboard", "wall", "central_air",
  "ecf_3R302", "ecf_3R303", "ecf_3R304", "ecf_3R305", "ecf_3R306", "ecf_3R307", "ecf_3R308",
  "ecf_3R309", "ecf_3R310", "ecf_3R311", "ecf_3R312", "ecf_3R313", "ecf_3R314", "ecf_3R315",
  "ecf_3R316", "ecf_3R317", "ecf_3R318", "ecf_3R319", "ecf_3R320", "ecf_3R321", "ecf_3R322",
  "ecf_3R323", "ecf_3R324", "ecf_3R325", "ecf_3R326", "months_1to9", "months_10to16", "months_17to24"
)

formula_bas <- reformulate(baserh, response = "ln_price")

mod_base <- codf$backward_p(formula_bas, data = df, p_out = 0.10, verbose = TRUE)

resbase  <- codf$assess_ln_price_model(df, mod_base)

df       <- resbase$data
df_in    <- resbase$data_inliers
resbase$rrmetrics_kable
```

```{r mod3a, results='asis'}
codf$model_metrics_A(mod_base, "District 3 LN\\_PRICE model fit statistics")
codf$coef_table(mod_base, "District 3 LN\\_PRICE model coefficients (95% CI)")
```

```{r mod3b}
mf <- model.frame(mod_base)
row_idx <- as.integer(rownames(mf))
aug_sppsf <- broom::augment(mod_base, data = df[row_idx, ]) |>
  dplyr::mutate(pred_sppsf = exp(.fitted), std_resid  = .std.resid)
codf$plot_residuals_vs_months(aug_sppsf, ptitle = "Residuals for LN_PRICE Model")
```

```{r mod3c}
codf$plot_leverage_histogram(model = mod_base, df = df, subtitle = "Dependent Variable: LN\\_PRICE")
```

```{r mod3d}
codf$pp_plot_resid(mod_base, dep_label = "LN_PRICE")
```

```{r mod3e}
codf$plot_stdresid_vs_stdpred(mod_base, dep_label = "LN_PRICE")
```

```{r mod3f}
codf$plot_cook_vs_rstudent(mod_base, dep_label = "LN_PRICE")
```

```{r mod3g}
codf$plot_lev_vs_rstudent(mod_base, dep_label = "LN_PRICE")
```

### Filtered Input

```{r mod3i}
mod_base_inliers <- codf$backward_p(formula_bas, data = df_in,
                                    p_out = 0.10, verbose = TRUE)

resbasei <- codf$refit_inlier_ln_price(
  df = df, df_in = df_in, formula_base = formula_bas, mod_base = mod_base
)

df_in            <- resbasei$data_inliers
dfa              <- resbasei$join_data
df_in1           <- resbasei$extract_data
```

```{r mod3ia, results='asis'}
codf$model_metrics_A(mod_base_inliers, "District 3 LN\\_PRICE (Inliers) model fit statistics")
codf$coef_table(mod_base_inliers, "District 3 LN\\_PRICE (Inliers) model coefficients (95% CI)")
```

```{r mod3ic}

```

```{r mod3id}
codf$pp_plot_resid(mod_base_inliers, dep_label = "LN_PRICE")
```

```{r mod3ie}
codf$plot_stdresid_vs_stdpred(mod_base_inliers, dep_label = "LN_PRICE")
```


## Model IV

```{r mod4}
tasprh1 <- c(
  "ln_landratio", "ln_base_bldgsize_ratio",  "arterial",
  "single_family1story", "half_duplex1story", "half_duplex2story",
  "smallest", "small", "large", "largest",  "two_plus_baths", "powder_room",
  "good", "fair", "poor", "very_poor_unsound",  "qabove_avg", "qbelow_avg",
  "yb_pre_1929", "yb_1946_to_1960", "yb_post_1961",  "crawl", "slab",
  "ln_garagespaces", "fireplace",  "hot_water", "elec_baseboard", "wall", "central_air",
  "ecf_3R302", "ecf_3R303", "ecf_3R304", "ecf_3R305", "ecf_3R306", "ecf_3R307", "ecf_3R308",
  "ecf_3R309", "ecf_3R310", "ecf_3R311", "ecf_3R312", "ecf_3R313", "ecf_3R314", "ecf_3R315",
  "ecf_3R316", "ecf_3R317", "ecf_3R318", "ecf_3R319", "ecf_3R320", "ecf_3R321", "ecf_3R322",
  "ecf_3R323", "ecf_3R324", "ecf_3R325", "ecf_3R326", "months_1to9", "months_10to16", "months_17to24"
)

formula_tas1 <- reformulate(tasprh1, response = "ln_tasp_re")

mod_tasp1 <- codf$backward_p(formula_tas1, data = dfa, p_out = 0.10, verbose = TRUE)

dfa <- dfa %>%
  mutate(
    pre_3 = predict(mod_tasp1, newdata = dfa), esp3  = exp(pre_3), ratio3 = esp3 / tasp_re
  )

rrmetrics <- codf$ratio_metrics(dfa, esp3, saleprice)

knitr::kable(
  rrmetrics,  format   = "latex",  booktabs = TRUE,
  caption  = "District 3 LN\\_TASP Model I assessing coefficients" 
) %>%  kable_styling(latex_options = c("hold_position", "striped"), font_size = 8)

tasprh2 <- c(
  "ln_landratio", "lnsbldsfint",  "arterial",
  "single_family1story", "half_duplex1story", "half_duplex2story",
  "smallest", "small", "large", "largest",  "two_plus_baths", "powder_room",
  "good", "fair", "poor", "very_poor_unsound",  "qabove_avg", "qbelow_avg",
  "yb_pre_1929", "yb_1946_to_1960", "yb_post_1961",  "crawl", "slab",  "garage", "fireplace",
  "hot_water", "elec_baseboard", "wall", "central_air",
  "ecf_3R302", "ecf_3R303", "ecf_3R304", "ecf_3R305", "ecf_3R306", "ecf_3R307", "ecf_3R308",
  "ecf_3R309", "ecf_3R310", "ecf_3R311", "ecf_3R312", "ecf_3R313", "ecf_3R314", "ecf_3R315",
  "ecf_3R316", "ecf_3R317", "ecf_3R318", "ecf_3R319", "ecf_3R320", "ecf_3R321", "ecf_3R322",
  "ecf_3R323", "ecf_3R324", "ecf_3R325", "ecf_3R326", "months_1to9", "months_10to16", "months_17to24"
)

formula_tas2 <- reformulate(tasprh2, response = "ln_tasp_re")

mod_tasp2 <- codf$backward_p(formula_tas2, data = dfa, p_out = 0.10, verbose = TRUE)

dfa <- dfa %>%
  mutate(
    pre_4 = predict(mod_tasp2, newdata = dfa), esp4 = exp(pre_4), ratio4 = esp4 / tasp_re
  )

rrmetrics <- codf$ratio_metrics(dfa, esp4, saleprice)

knitr::kable(
  rrmetrics,  format   = "latex",  booktabs = TRUE,
  caption  = "District 3 LN\\_TASP Model II assessing coefficients" 
) %>%  kable_styling(latex_options = c("hold_position", "striped"), font_size = 8)
```

```{r mod4a, results='asis'}
codf$model_metrics_A(mod_tasp1, "District 3 LN\\_TASP Model I fit statistics")
codf$coef_table(mod_tasp1, "District 3 LN\\_TASP Model I coefficients (95% CI)")
```

```{r mod4b, results='asis'}
codf$model_metrics_A(mod_tasp2, "District 3 LN\\_TASP Model II fit statistics")
codf$coef_table(mod_tasp2, "District 3 LN\\_TASP Model II coefficients (95% CI)")
```
